title: Dated S&P 400 and S&P 600 sector price indexes (COO ruling 38 Part B, continuation Fix 3)
price_note: Total return = the dividend-adjusted close already used in the breadth history. Adjusted closes are today's restated values (split and dividend adjustment as of the Tiingo archive capture 2026-10-11..16), not the prices printed at the time. Data end 2026-10-09.
redistribution_note: Group-level index levels and counts only; no member prices, tickers or per-security dates. Member-level history stays off git.

index.rebalance_rule: engine.baskets._ew_level: equal-weight daily total-return level, cumprod of (1 + EW daily return) from 1.0 at the first active session; a member counts only inside its membership window
index.floor_rule: first date per key = earliest session with at least 5 priced members; rows below 5 keep n_priced_members with a blank index
index.floor_gap: below-floor sessions are blank; the chain stays flat across the gap and resumes from the last valid level

never_pooled: The S&P 500, 400 and 600 indexes are never pooled.

file.name: group_index_daily_dated_sp400_sp600.parquet
file.membership: dated S&P 400 / S&P 600 membership (sp1500_pit_membership src=sp400 / src=sp600) x as-of-now GICS sector classification (sp1500_pit_sectors); each universe is indexed separately and never combined with sp500 or with each other

sp400.labels: as-of-now GICS sector classification (sp1500_pit_sectors); NOT era-correct

sp600.labels: as-of-now GICS sector classification (sp1500_pit_sectors); NOT era-correct

known_gaps.dropped_partial_rows_rule: centred 21-row median of priced names; a row under half is dropped (data cleaning, not a signal rule)
known_gaps.below_floor_rule: sessions with fewer than 5 priced in-window members keep n_priced_members with a blank index; per-universe per-sector counts are in universes.<src>.below_floor_sessions_per_sector
known_gaps.unlabeled_rows_rule: membership rows with no sector classification are absent from every sector index (counts in universes.<src>.coverage)
known_gaps.unpriced_in_window_rule: membership rows with no stored close inside their own [start_date, end_date) window contribute nothing (counts in universes.<src>.coverage); a ticker present in the store only outside its window is a likely ticker reuse

price_input.note: the same closes the dated sp500 sector index uses

duplicate_series_rule: month-by-month hash of daily returns, then pairwise check: >=60 identical returns and >=95% identical between first and last identical session; the second ticker is counted once over the span. Detection and labelling only; no store repaired. Pair tickers are not committed (group-level counts only).
no_outcomes: Data only. Descriptive group levels and counts. No outcome relation, no backtest, no hit rate, no signal, ranking or score column.
engine: engine.baskets._ew_level; scripts/build_group_breadth_history.py membership_dated / drop_partial_rows / duplicate_series_pairs / unpriced_in_window; prior-round method /tmp/r38b/build_house.py dated_index
